questions.question: What label should the status badge display?

content.text: Do not use the tool this time. End your reply with one plain question to me about whether the badge should blink.

No tool used, and the reply closes on one plain question as you asked.

Three answers are held: amber fill, the label "Needs review", and support for Web plus iOS plus Android. Nothing has been written, the working tree is unchanged and no branch exists.

The blocker stays as a statement rather than a question. There is still no widget in this project to carry a badge, so those answers wait on a target, and a plugin at `.pi/PLUGINS.md` is irrelevant to that.

Should the badge blink?
